inputs.customer_message:
Hi Elena,

Thank you for being a Northwind Robotics customer. With your subscription renewing on October 31, 2026, I wanted to reach out directly.

I'm aware that your team has seen a significant change in usage over the past month, and I know that support case CS-1042 — covering the SCIM deprovisioning delay — remains open with an engineering review in progress. I want to acknowledge that disruption and make sure we get the right people engaged. I'd like to schedule a call with our support team so we can give you a clear status update and next steps; I won't make promises about timing or resolution that I can't stand behind, but I do want to make sure this gets the attention it deserves.

On the commercial side, I'd like to propose a renewal at a discounted annual rate that reflects both your stated budget and our commitment to the partnership. The exact approved terms will be included with this message by our system.

A few things I'd like to discuss on a call:
- Current usage patterns and whether there are features or integrations we can better activate for your team
- The open SCIM case and a direct line to the engineering team
- How our provisioning and audit retention capabilities compare to any alternatives you're evaluating

Please let me know a time that works, and I'll make sure the right people are on the call.

Best regards
inputs.rationale:
Northwind Robotics (ACC-2291) is at high renewal risk ahead of the October 31, 2026 renewal date (list price $12,000/yr).

Evidence from gtm-account-context (Aug–Oct 2026):

1. evt-northwind-001 – Usage decline: Successful sign-ins dropped from 85,000 to 42,000 in 30 days; active seats fell from 220 to 140. Cause is unverified; may or may not be related to the open SCIM case.

2. evt-northwind-002 – Competitive pressure: Procurement is comparing a competitor quote of $9,000/yr. Scope equivalence (automated provisioning, audit retention) is unverified by the AE.

3. evt-northwind-003 – Open support case CS-1042: SCIM deprovisioning is delayed; engineering review is pending; no resolution date confirmed.

4. evt-northwind-004 – Budget constraint: Customer states an $8,400/yr budget cap and requests 30% off. Finance has not confirmed that cap. No discounted offer is currently signed.

A 30% discount yields $8,400/yr net, matching the stated budget and undercutting the competitor quote. This discount exceeds the AE self-service limit of 15% and requires manager (Riley) approval.
